data.title: 缪尔赛思 · 泳池中央召唤水人偶的水花恶作剧
data.action: 半身浸在温热澄澈的度假泳池中，双手在水面上轻轻一扬，数枚透明水球伴随水花腾空旋转，笑眼盈盈地泼洒向镜头
data.location: 生态温室穹顶下的热带水生植物花园无边泳池
data.lighting: 透过温室玻璃穹顶的明澈阳光在清澈泳池中打出无数道跳跃的波光光网，水珠在空气中如钻石般耀眼
data.mood: 灵动俏皮、水波烂漫与不羁的亲近依恋
data.description: 澄澈池水在她的掌控下欢快起伏。缪尔赛思精灵般的尖耳微动，金发被水汽浸得微贴在娇艳脸颊上，双手轻巧地一挥，池水立刻化作几只圆滚滚的小水球在半空中滴溜溜打转，猝不及防地朝你溅来几滴清凉的水珠。她歪头眨了眨绿眸，促狭地笑出声来——「哇，全中！被水精灵偷袭的感觉怎么样？莱茵生命的水质测试合格啦，接下来……要不要下来和我比比谁游得更快？」
data.promptProse: Muelsyse wades waist-deep through a tropical greenhouse infinity pool in her gradient cyan halter bikini trimmed with glass beads and a translucent pareo. Flicking both hands across the water to spin clear orbs and spray droplets toward the viewer, she tilts her head with a teasing wink beneath bright morning sunbeams.
data.animaCaption: Waist-deep in the sunlit greenhouse pool in her shimmering cyan halter bikini, she flicks clear water orbs into the air and splashes toward the camera with a mischievous wink. Morning beams through the glass dome sparkle across every floating droplet.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a shimmering gradient cyan sheer-layered halter bikini trimmed with dewdrop glass beads and a translucent floating pareo.
